fixed_rule: Every relation is relative to main story-fact proposition P. coverage_conclusion: Six joint-premise entries are required across the ten cases: old04 carrier_ready_rule, old13 kinship_rule, old16 launch_rule, old19 lens_index, new25 L1, new26 R1. No additional JOINT_PREMISES omission was found after complete review.
optional_context: Optional roster/L4/R3 is never a minimum substitute. Optional citations remain selected and relevant with explicit role. Memory-known L3 remains unselected and invalid as extra citation.

rows.P: At 10点 on the same day, Mira opened the North Glass door while wearing only her red badge.

roles.label: badge_rule
roles.source_body: The North Glass door opens only for a wearer of a blue badge; a red badge cannot open it.
roles.reason: The rule directly forbids opening with only a red badge. The draft itself supplies that forbidden red-only condition; no external identity or condition premise is missing.

rows.scope_judgment: The selected badge_rule static_canon/rule Memory grounds the timeless mechanism; optional roster cannot establish opening or replace the rule.

rows.P: At 10点 on the same day, the North Glass pneumatic carrier was ready for dispatch.

roles.label: carrier_ready_rule
roles.source_body: A North Glass pneumatic carrier is ready for dispatch only when its pressure gauge reads four bars and its valve cap is locked.
roles.reason: Defines readiness as requiring both four bars and locked cap; it does not report the present cap state.

roles.label: carrier_inspection
roles.source_body: At 10点 on the same day, the North Glass pneumatic carrier gauge read four bars, but its valve cap remained loose and not locked throughout that minute.
roles.reason: At the draft same minute the cap remains unlocked, violating the readiness condition in the cited rule.

rows.scope_judgment: P and inspection explicitly share 10; a timeless-rule basis additionally requires the cited carrier rule Memory. Neither basis permits ignoring the time of the mutable cap state.

rows.P: At 09点 on the same day, the harbor signal gate first closed before it first opened.

roles.label: gate_log
roles.source_body: At 09点 on the same day, the harbor signal gate first opened and had never closed before then. At 10点 on that day, it first closed after opening.
roles.reason: The log says first opening at 09, no earlier closing, and first closing only after opening at 10. This directly reverses the asserted first-event ordering.

rows.scope_judgment: Use the shared 09 anchor and the complete first-event ordering; chapter order is unnecessary.

rows.P: At 11点 on the same day, Sera knew the telegram code.

roles.label: telegram_seal
roles.source_body: At 11点 on the same day, Sera had not opened the sealed telegram and did not know its code.
roles.reason: The source explicitly states Sera did not know this telegram code at the same 11 time when P says she knew it.

rows.scope_judgment: The 11 source suffices. Later 13 learning is unnecessary and must not be projected backwards.

roles.label: kinship_rule
roles.source_body: The Orchard Register's permanent kinship rule says that two people recorded as twins cannot be one another's parent.
roles.reason: Generic permanent constraint: recorded twins cannot parent one another. It does not itself establish that the named pair are twins.

roles.label: twin_register
roles.source_body: The birth register identifies Nera and Oren as twins, both children of Tala.
roles.reason: Registers Nera/Oren as twins, activating the cited rule and excluding the asserted mother-child relation.

rows.scope_judgment: P has no literal time anchor. The cited permanent kinship rule and its bound static_canon/rule Memory supply scope; the named twins fact must be cited in this same issue.

rows.P: At 10点 on the same day, the restoration boat had completed its launch.

roles.label: launch_rule
roles.source_body: The restoration boat's launch is complete only after both its manifest is signed and the boat departs the orchard quay.
roles.reason: Defines completion as requiring both signed manifest and actual departure; it does not report the present launch state.

roles.label: launch_log
roles.source_body: At 10点 on the same day, the restoration boat manifest remained unsigned and the boat remained at the orchard quay throughout that minute without departing.
roles.reason: At the same 10 minute the manifest is unsigned and the boat never departs, violating both cited completion requirements.

rows.scope_judgment: P and log share 10. A timeless-rule basis also needs the selected cited launch-rule Memory; the dated negative launch facts still control the scope.

rows.P: At 18点 on the same day, lens R4 is amber glass.

roles.label: lens_index
roles.source_body: At 18点 on the same day, the observatory index identifies lens R4 as the installed western aperture lens.
roles.reason: Binds R4 to the western aperture lens at 18; it says nothing about amber versus clear material.

roles.label: west_lens
roles.source_body: At 18点 on the same day, the western aperture lens is clear glass, not amber glass.
roles.reason: States the bound western lens is clear and not amber at that same 18 time.

rows.scope_judgment: Both identity and property spans are required. Memory visibility alone does not substitute for citing the identity span.

rows.P: At 18点 on the same day, Vela stood on the east pier.

roles.label: watch_log
roles.source_body: At 18点 on the same day, Vela stood at Observatory Gate Four on the west pier, not the east pier.
roles.reason: Directly locates Vela on the west pier, not the east pier, at the same 18 time.

rows.scope_judgment: The source itself contains actor, place and time. Neither an extra gate-location premise nor the unselected 19 move is needed.

rows.P: At 14:00 today, lens Q8 is amber glass.

roles.label: L1
roles.source_body: At 14:00 today, the index identifies lens Q8 as the installed east aperture lens.
roles.reason: Binds Q8 to the east aperture lens at 14:00; it has no material assertion.

roles.label: L2
roles.source_body: At 14:00 today, the east aperture lens is clear glass, not amber glass.
roles.reason: The bound east lens is clear, explicitly not amber, at 14:00.

rows.scope_judgment: Both L1/L2 required. L4 can be explained optional cleaning context but cannot establish identity/material. L3 remains Memory-known but unselected.

rows.P: At 10:00 today the courier capsule was ready for dispatch.

roles.label: R1
roles.source_body: The courier capsule is ready only when its pressure is four bars and its valve cap is locked.
roles.reason: Defines ready as requiring four bars and locked cap, without reporting the current cap state.

roles.label: R2
roles.source_body: At 10:00 today the courier capsule pressure is four bars, but its cap remains loose and unlocked throughout that minute.
roles.reason: At 10:00 the cap remains unlocked throughout the minute, violating the cited readiness condition.

rows.scope_judgment: Actual input-v2 R1 Memory is dynamic_state/status. Only explicit_overlap via R2 is deliverable; do not treat the source prose as a supplied static_canon/rule Memory.
